scope: First seal and cap inputs; numbers labelled exploratory are scenarios, not confidence intervals or measurements. Values describe initial films unless a time dependence is given.
reference_state: Room-temperature bulk or pass4 estimates, not measured 0.1-20 nm films under the UC Davis beam. Beam temperature must come from each transport case. All energies here are LAB projectile energies unless explicitly stated; equal D masses imply E_lab=2 E_cm for D+.

sources.sc_hydride: McGuire and Kempter, J Chem Phys 33 (1960), https://doi.org/10.1063/1.1731452, OSTI abstract https://www.osti.gov/biblio/4097719
sources.er_deuteride: Rodriguez et al., Powder Diffraction 23 (2008) 259-264, https://doi.org/10.1154/1.2959575; room-temperature fluorite ErH(2-x)Dx lattice parameter a=5.1287-0.00011120*(mole percent D) angstrom, publisher abstract https://impact.ornl.gov/en/publications/x-ray-powder-diffraction-data-for-erhsub2-xsubdsubxsub/
sources.ti_diffusion: Kaess et al., J Alloys Compd 259 (1997) 74-82, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0925838897001242; abstract identified via search; numeric range retained in transport/lit/notes.md, not independently extracted from full paper
sources.oxide_ald: ALD stoichiometric Er2O3 on Si, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0169433212008641; search-indexed abstract reports 0.12 +/- 0.01 nm/cycle, not Pd nucleation or coverage
sources.al_barrier: Robinson et al., J Phys Mater 9 (2026) 015007, https://doi.org/10.1088/2515-7639/ae2544, D permeation ALD alumina study; source search excerpt only, not a source for a 1 nm barrier factor
sources.implant: 6.6 keV D+ into Ti, https://doi.org/10.1080/00337578008209259; pass4 notes report room-temperature TiD~1.8 under implantation, not vacuum survival of unsupported caps

shared_rules.profile: forward.consumer takes z_top,z_bottom,n_host,n_D,Z,M_amu,n_metal, all number densities per m3; adsorption nads separately. Preserve explicit elemental species in stopping (Bragg additivity), using 2.014 amu for D; do not apply unsupported-element ICRU or invent a measured Z-effective stopping curve. n_metal excludes O and D; hydrogen present in the stopping inventory must be counted exactly once.

coverage.status: exploratory end members; no coverage-versus-cycle measurement on Pd supplied
coverage.consumer: parallel covered/uncovered columns, area weight physical yields and erosion; lateral transport, film percolation and edges omitted

retention.unit: fraction of initially loaded D remaining
retention.status: exploratory extreme cases; neither is a kinetic bound; do not call an arbitrary constant retention a measured lifetime
retention.consumer: time-dependent cap n_D and sputter lifecycle
retention.uncertainty: outgassing, beam-stimulated desorption, oxidation, replenishment and local temperature can change ranking

surface_baseline.status: pass4 retained model estimates; not g5_recomb qualified, no barrier-to-sticking equivalence
surface_baseline.consumer: Pd substrate transport; no material-specific promoter parameters implied

shared_rules.erosion: Film atom inventory per area is n_total*d, with n_total including D only if sputter yield counts that species; removal time n_total*d/(incident D flux*Y_atoms_per_D) assumes fixed composition, no regrowth, angle or redeposition. Use f_Dplus=0.85 and f_D2plus=0.15 per charged particle, D2+ gives two deuterons at half D+ energy, normalized per incident D by 1.15. Stopping, D loss and preferential sputtering may invalidate constant Y and inventory.

oxide_D_diffusion_exploration.status: Uncalibrated exploratory endpoints chosen to span slow and fast relaxation, not source-derived or proven physical bounds; no central value. Cross-material transfer is not a D measurement. Fixed at 300 K only: activation energy, isotope shift, pressure, microstructure and radiation dependence are unknown.
oxide_D_diffusion_exploration.consumer: Only a transient oxide concentration model that separately declares solubility and interfacial resistance; do not independently combine this arbitrary D bracket with the pass4 permeability central as though both measured the same constitutive law.
oxide_D_diffusion_exploration.decision_effect: For nanometre films the relaxation time scale d^2/D spans far less than a second to years; film continuity and coupled solubility can dominate.

density.status: pass4 nominal ALD film estimate, 3.05 derived from 1.8e28 formula units and 101.96 g/mol

stopping.status: formula inputs for existing LS/ZBL elemental-sum stopping, not measured film stopping

permeability.status: central pass4 deliberately chosen estimate, extremes factor-100 exploratory, not experimental confidence bounds
permeability.consumer: series permeance permeability/thickness, subject to assumed square-root-pressure law; holes separate parallel channels

D_diffusion_m2_s.status: not separately identified; permeability is solubility times diffusion only within chosen constitutive law; do not infer diffusivity without solubility

sputter.status: pass4 estimate 0.6 times TiO2 proxy; uncertainty multipliers exploratory, not measured bounds

materials.notes: At 2 nm pass4 model 95% atom removal 0.743-1.633 h for E_lab 0.5-13 keV in selected IV cases; this is not measured permeance lifetime. Growth or cracks can dominate.

density.status: dense bulk theoretical density proxy, not ALD film; NIST SCD Z00642 https://srdata.nist.gov/CeramicDataPortal/Scd/Z00642; n_formula=rho*N_A/382.515 g mol^-1

stopping.status: stoichiometric species; elemental-sum model, not measured stopping

permeability.status: explicit alumina proxy and exploratory 100-fold limits; Er2O3 permeability not measured
permeability.consumer: series permeance only under same constitutive assumption

sputter.status: exploratory cross-material proxy; unknown Er-specific preferential sputtering

materials.notes: ALD Er2O3 on Si is not proof of closed ultrathin film on Pd.

stopping.status: pass4 TiD2 BCA composition; elemental stopping including D

diffusion.status: pass4 modeled prefactor and literature Ea; 300 K value ~2.5e-17 m2/s; not bulk Ti metal; concentration and irradiation dependencies omitted

sputter.status: Ti metal proxy only; hydride D and preferential loss unresolved

density.status: derived from measured RT ErH(2-x)Dx fluorite Vegard line at 100 mol% D; nM=4/a^3, nD=2nM, stoichiometric dense bulk; ALD film deviations unmeasured

diffusion.status: explicit TiD2 cross-material exploratory proxy, no ErD2 diffusion measurement asserted

sputter.status: exploratory cross-material proxy, not ErD2 data

density.status: H-to-D proxy from room-temperature stoichiometric YH2 fluorite a=5.20 A reported in https://arxiv.org/html/1102.0450v2 section 3.2; assumed unchanged on deuteration; mass adjusted for D. Thin sputtered films in source have a=5.26 A and unknown oxygen/H contents, not ALD films.
